aspect: Spacing is what reduces risk, and requires agreement
description: Short inter-pregnancy intervals raise maternal and neonatal risk. Achieving longer ones requires either a partner's cooperation or covert use.
energy_note: A medical decision requiring somebody else's consent.

aspect: Covert use is common and is its own risk
description: Injectables and implants are chosen partly because they are undetectable. The clinical choice is being made on grounds of concealment rather than suitability.
energy_note: Choosing the method he cannot find.

description: Where family size is high and skilled attendance is at 43%, the cumulative lifetime risk of maternal death is the per-birth risk compounded across births.
energy_note: The same dice, thrown six times.

description: She tells him she is going to the market. The clinic is forty minutes the other way. She is back before four with vegetables she bought on the way home so the story holds.
energy_note: A covert operation, to space her own children.

description: She is thirty-one. The fourth delivery was a haemorrhage and the doctor at Katsina said plainly that another would be dangerous. Her husband's family have been clear that the two boys are not enough. She has not told anyone she is pregnant.
energy_note: A medical warning, overruled by a household.
